claims.text: The source animates any personalised text-to-image model without per-model tuning: inflate SD-V1.5 to 5D (image layers per-frame, motion merges spatial to batch); insert temporal Transformer self-attention with sinusoidal positions and zero-initialised residuals, base frozen; LoRA domain adapter on attention fits the video-data quality gap (scaled by alpha, 0 removes it at inference); MotionLoRA LoRA on motion attention for new shot types (20-50 videos, 2000 iterations, ~1-2 h, ~30 MB, composable).

Reported numbers: same personalised models, ranked text/domain/smoothness: this work average-user-ratings 2.21/2.28/2.825 and CLIP 31.39/87.29/98.00 vs Tune-a-Video 2.18/1.10/1.615 and T2V-Zero 1.62/2.62/1.56; MotionLoRA 50 references OK, 5 degrades to texture; temporal-convolution ablation collapses to identical frames.
